**Post-fix samples, not pooled.**  Two oracle samples of the pipeline after the ROADMAP 3.8 unfreeze, independent and blind mode on the 23 papers of ROADMAP 3.2–3.7 (both predate the R7 paper of ROADMAP 3.9, so this table stays 23-paper): post-fix 1 (label `desktop-opus-postfix`; `pipeline-oracle-desktop-opus-postfix-23papers-indep-blind-2026-11-03.json`; ROADMAP 3.8.1), in which the sample-size check never fired, and post-fix 2 (label `desktop-opus-postfix2`; `pipeline-oracle-desktop-opus-postfix2-23papers-indep-blind-2026-11-05.json`; ROADMAP 3.8.3), run after the fix of ROADMAP 3.8.2, in which it fires.  The fixes were designed after reading the evaluation results, so both rows are post hoc: they are shown beside the three frozen samples of the tables above, never pooled with them or with each other, and never paired with the agent in a gap range.  One draw each, no standard error.  *Against frozen range* compares a post-fix count with the lowest and highest of the three frozen samples in that cell.  The error-refinement count includes completeness and timeout repairs, which share its budget; the rows do not carry `n_completeness_refinements`.
